term: constant-additive measurement and shared calibration anchor
definition: For input carrier X and an additive commutative group V, a profile predicts f(x)+b using a signal function f and one input-independent bias b. SameReadings compares all predicted outputs. OffsetShift changes f to f+d while replacing b by b−d. The calibration clause supplies x₀ and k such that both compared signal functions equal k there; it does not encode knowledge, independence, or correctness of that supplied reference.
note: Analyst model motivated by Duhem’s bundle/auxiliary distinction, not attributed to him and not asserted of real instruments. Additivity, constant bias and exact outputs are model restrictions. Source fidelity would require a separate model of an actual measurement procedure.
